item_short_desc: Rothco’s Multi-Purpose SWAT Elbow Pads are designed to provide exceptional protection and comfort during intense activities. Constructed from tough 900 Denier polyester, these elbow pads feature a robust 1/2 inch foam padding that ensures reliable cushioning for your elbows, minimizing impact and reducing discomfort. The non-slip rubber caps offer excellent traction, keeping your elbows stable on various surfaces. A dual hook and loop fastening system allows you to securely adjust the pads for a comfortable and snug fit.
